title: Supercharger Sauce (Greek Yogurt Version)
description: A lighter, high-protein remix of the viral crispy chicken wrap "supercharger sauce" — 0% Greek yogurt swapped in for mayo and Frank's sweet chili sauce for extra kick. Smoky, tangy, and a little spicy.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine 50g 0% plain Greek yogurt and 1 tbsp Frank's sweet chili sauce.
Add 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, and 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper.
Stir in 1 tsp white vinegar and 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce.
Season with a pinch of salt and a pinch of black pepper, then whisk until smooth.
Taste and adjust spice or tang to preference. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 3 days.
notes: Swapping 40g low-fat mayo for 50g 0% Greek yogurt keeps this creamy while cutting fat and boosting protein. Frank's sweet chili sauce adds a bit more heat and tang than a plain sweet chili sauce. Great on crispy air-fried chicken strip wraps, as a dip, or drizzled over rice bowls.
